constraints.description: qwen3.8-max must come from the pinned liter-llm snapshot consumed by the build, with no temporary runtime overlay.

validation.validation_method: Inspect gitlink, Cargo.lock, refresh script, generated catalog, and runtime source diff.

constraints.description: Provider catalog regeneration must use locked local inputs and produce a byte-stable snapshot.

validation.validation_method: Repeat the local refresh and compare SHA-256 digests.

constraints.description: Pricing units, limits, and capabilities must be transformed from liter-llm into the UAR catalog without semantic drift.

validation.validation_method: Compare liter-llm qwen3.8-max source fields with the generated UAR record.

constraints.description: Native bootstrap may migrate only the exact phase-owned Alibaba seed and must preserve custom or API-created configuration.

validation.validation_method: Review exact-match implementation and observed custom-configuration negative control.

constraints.description: No literal provider credential may be written into tracked artifacts, documentation, KBD history, or retained operational evidence.

validation.validation_method: Scan intended artifact paths and evidence for credential values without printing those values.

constraints.description: Documentation, OpenSpec tasks, and verification rows must match observed platform and real-inference evidence without cross-profile claims.

validation.validation_method: Independent artifact-validator review of claims and retained output.

global_rules: Do not rerun real inference during artifact QA.
Do not inspect or stage unrelated KBD projection churn.
Do not claim Linux or Windows runtime deployment from a macOS host.
termination_conditions: All manifest references exist and are non-empty.
The independent artifact-validator reports no blocking finding.
